Ej.bar_b_note: An empty cream plaster box with outdoor grass growing through the floor and no storm reading through the blown-out window sinks it; nothing says Stormwood.

Ff.bar_b_note: B's torn-down banners, opened cage, collapsed tent and smoke give site-specific aftermaths, but smeared flat ground textures, blobby low-poly trees and a flat sky keep both sides well short of Palworld's finish.

Lf.bar_b_note: A's dark gold-veined scales are close to the Fulgocobra board but the coiled pose hides the hood and the ruler; B's flat black-and-yellow banding drifts off-board and its faint frames float a metre off the stage.

By.bar_b_note: The purple sky, rain and gold ground lightning carry the storm mood, but a uniform dark mud ground, blobby trees, Meadows-style cottages and creatures shorter than the trainer sink it.

Nf.bar_b_note: Massive trunks, blue glow mushrooms and the violet sky gap give the strongest Stormwood mood of the batch, but crushed dark values, no readable fallen-giant landmark and camera-filling fog puffs in v04 fading sink it.

Jm.bar_b_note: A clean, appealing elder with expressive eyes, readable white hair and an earthy green-and-brown outfit sits at a shipping stylised-character finish, held back only by a slightly oversized head in the full-body view.

Pq.bar_b_note: Called an overlook, it shows no vista: a flat dark ground carpet runs to an empty lilac horizon behind evenly spaced blob trees, and only the rain and lightning carry any mood.

Eu.bar_b_note: The gold-and-blue Voltarach is readable, but the player's creature is near invisible, the telegraphs are flat magenta outlines, the HUD covers about a third of each frame, and in A (i11, i13, i15) the canopy fills the camera.

top_changes.change: Rebuild the Stormwood ground and value structure: replace the uniform dark mud plus tuft carpet with moss, root, rock and black-pool transitions, lift the midtones, and add fog depth and light shafts so landmarks (fallen giant, overlook vista) read at 30% size

Fix creature scale and grounding: every Stormwood creature taller than the 1.80 m trainer, Fulgocobra faint poses kept on the ground with its hood and olive/gold veined board palette, and the player's creature kept readable in fights

Fight and interior cameras: keep the fight camera out of canopy, swap flat magenta telegraphs for real lightning/stone effects, slim the HUD, and stop terrain grass from rendering inside the Ashfoot shelter
